description: List every interaction EVENT you can attach to a node: the triggers (eventName: click/hover/success/submit/…) and the actions (open_page, scroll_to, toggle, open_popup, add_to_cart, buy_now, phone_call, open_link, …) with the exact extra fields each action needs. Attach via new_element/new_section opts.events (ids are auto-minted, e.g. opts.events=[{ action:'add_to_cart', open_page:'cart' }]).
name: list_events
